paper_title: Gated Attention for Large Language Models Non-linearity, Sparsity, and   Attention-Sink-Free
caption: Comparison of massive activations and attention sink phenomena across different gating configurations. Row 1 (Baseline): Significant massive activations and attention sinks emerge after the 6th layer. Row 2 (SDPA Gating): Reduced activations and no attention sinks observed. Row 3 (Value Layer Gating): Similar activations to Row 2 but with residual attention sinks. Rows 4–5 (Reduced Sparsity via cross-head share and NS-sigmoid): Massive activations and attention sinks resemble the baseline.

model_annotations.Bulgarian: The figure illustrates a comparison of the first token attention score across different model layers for various gating configurations, with the primary focus on tracking changes in attention behavior as a function of layer depth. The horizontal axis (x-axis) is labeled "layer" and represents the model layer number, with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 22. The axis is marked at intervals of 5, with visible tick labels at 0, 5, 10, 15, and 20. The vertical axis (y-axis) is labeled "first token attention score" and uses a linear scale from 0.0 to 1.0, with tick marks and labels at 0.0, 0.2, 0.4, 0.6, 0.8, and 1.0. A horizontal dashed green line is plotted at a y-value of 0.048, which is labeled in the legend as "mean: 0.048". There is a single data line, represented by a solid blue line, which plots the first token attention score for each layer. The line begins at a score of approximately 0.05 at layer 0, dips slightly below 0.05 around layer 2, then rises to a peak of approximately 0.12 at layer 5. It then fluctuates, showing a second peak of about 0.08 at layer 10, followed by a series of smaller peaks and troughs, including a peak of approximately 0.08 at layer 20, before ending at a score of approximately 0.03 at layer 22. The line remains generally below the mean line, with the highest point observed around layer 5.
model_annotations.Chinese: The line chart displays the first token attention score across different layers for the `atten_output_gate` configuration, with the x-axis representing the layer number ranging from 0 to 22 in increments of 5, and the y-axis showing the first token attention score on a scale from 0.0 to 1.0. The blue solid line represents the first token attention score, which remains near 0.0 for most layers, showing a slight increase around layer 5 with a peak value of approximately 0.11, followed by a general decline and fluctuation near 0.0. The green dashed line indicates the mean attention score of 0.048, which remains constant across all layers. The chart illustrates that the attention score varies slightly across layers but remains low overall, with no significant attention sink or massive activation observed in this configuration.
model_annotations.German: Das Diagramm zeigt den Aufmerksamkeitswert des ersten Tokens (first token attention score) über die Schichten (layer) für eine bestimmte Gating-Konfiguration, wobei die y-Achse den Aufmerksamkeitswert im Bereich von 0.0 bis 1.0 in linearer Skala darstellt und die x-Achse die Schichtnummer von 0 bis 22 in gleichmäßigen Abständen von 5 zeigt. Die y-Achsenbeschriftung lautet „first token attention score“, die x-Achsenbeschriftung „layer“. Zwei Linien sind dargestellt: eine durchgezogene blaue Linie, die den „first token attention score“ repräsentiert, und eine gestrichelte grüne Linie, die den Mittelwert (mean: 0.048) darstellt. Die blaue Linie beginnt bei etwa 0.02 bei Schicht 0, steigt bis zu einem Maximum von etwa 0.11 bei Schicht 5, fällt dann auf etwa 0.04 bei Schicht 10, bleibt bis Schicht 15 relativ stabil mit geringen Schwankungen um 0.03, steigt kurzfristig auf etwa 0.08 bei Schicht 20 und sinkt dann auf etwa 0.02 bei Schicht 22. Die grüne Linie bleibt konstant bei 0.048 über den gesamten Bereich der x-Achse.
